text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару bestows onto
Мэйсё Дото a
ray of light, signaling
good luck and a successful
victory.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Having received this ray of light, we
head for the
Takarazuka Kinen. This will
be the test to
determine whether Meisho
Doto can become the
knight to protect
Т.М. Опера О.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur informs me that, at last,
Мэйсё Дото's
numbers are sufficient to
exert her full potential.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, a problem lies ahead. Meisho
Doto,
Т.М. Опера О, and Air Shakur
must all push
themselves past their
limits.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
